title: Intuitive Machines, Inc. Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At March 31, cash was USD 231.624 million, long-term debt USD 335.844 million, and 216,819,088 Class A and Class C shares were outstanding.
summary: The unchanged Q1 Form 10-Q remains the latest periodic filing and primary evidence for operating scale, backlog, cash burn, liquidity, debt, dilution, contract risks and the pre-Goonhilly financial baseline.
